title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: To You Who Are Surprisingly Close, and to You Who Feel Breathtakingly Far Away 4
content: “No.”
Summoning all the courage I could muster, I revealed my honest feelings about the luck that had rolled into my life, despite being a timid person who could only steal glances.
“I want to live with you in that house for as long as possible.”

I was surprised at my own boldness. It was a display of courage that seemed unimaginable for someone who had been content merely watching her from the corner of the classroom. It might be reckless courage, but still.
Well, it was indeed reckless. I shrugged my shoulders. After all, Erika already knew how I felt.
Is it creepy? Yeah, it’s creepy. I’m definitely creepy.
But it can’t be helped. I want to be with Erika, as close as possible; that’s just who I am. If I embrace it, most of the creepiness can be considered a part of my personality.
If it’s too far away to breathe, then I just have to shout as loud as I can.
“Besides, I’m the type to neglect cleaning when I live alone!”
And then I wavered and escaped into humor. Someone, please, knock this coward out of me.

Erika sighed at my joke and smiled, seemingly relieved for some reason. Perhaps she thought a formidable enemy had appeared and I had faltered? Were my feelings for her genuine? That earlier question might have been her way of asking if I was prepared for that.
Erika said, “Thank you for showing me your choice and for answering my unaskable question.”
Erika performed a graceful bow. Behind her, a massive Forest Dragon tilted its head, and Shara stood there, dumbfounded.
“If that’s the case, then let’s make a choice and reach out.”
Erika looked at my face.
“I also want to live with you in that house until the very end.”

I desperately closed my mouth, which was about to shout. The joy bubbling up from my feet pounded in my chest, and my brain sounded a fanfare. My body felt surprisingly light. I felt like I could slice off a single hair from my master. No, that’s impossible.
But something as large as that castle-sized Forest Dragon? I could take it on. I steadied my trembling body and slowly nodded back at Erika.
In response, Erika unleashed flames.
“Then shall we take down the castle? What, it’s made of dead wood.”
Her smile was filled with fire.
“Let it burn well.”
“I don’t really understand, but could you please stop resolving a crisis in the middle of a crisis!?”

Shara shouted, unable to hold back any longer. She really didn’t get it. That wasn’t a crisis; it was Erika asking if I was prepared to stand beside her. If that was the case, then I shouldn’t falter in front of a mere giant Forest Dragon. Well, I wasn’t faltering. And Erika rewarded me for not backing down. This was definitely not a crisis.

As expected of Erika, her way of questioning my resolve was both lovely and fierce. Just as I thought that, we leaped at the same time Shara shouted. The massive Forest Dragon’s foreleg came crashing down. We landed, brushing aside the exploding earth and grass.
“So, Shara, we’re going to hunt that thing for our home, so please run away.”

I said to Shara amidst the pattering rain of dirt. I certainly didn’t think of dragging her into this. Although she hadn’t completely run out of magic, she had used enough to temporarily incapacitate herself, making her no longer a fighting force.
“I don’t understand anything, but you two are going to take that down, right?”
Shara said, wriggling down from Erika’s shoulder.
“If that’s the case, then you can’t run away. I’m still your companion, after all.”
In the worst-case scenario, I’d just carry Erika and escape! Leave it to me! I was exasperated at Shara, who silently declared she would abandon me, and I couldn’t help but laugh.
“Then I’ll stay by Erika’s side.”

I told Erika while silently asking Shara to take care of things. Since I had mostly been solo in Faltarl, the unspoken communication felt oddly enjoyable. I confirmed Erika’s nod in agreement and stepped forward.

If I was going to take down such a large dragon, it would take all day. Shara, the firepower, would probably be useless. Now, what should I do? I exchanged glares with the Forest Dragon, which was glaring at me fiercely. Oh, do you think that kind of glare will work on me? Go ahead and breathe fire. —As I faced it, I could feel the golden magic power overflowing around us.
“Well then, Shin.”
Erika’s voice was surprisingly casual.
“Now, I will show you my ‘good side’ this time.”
I had only memories of seeing your good side since I was born, you know?
“Please protect me, okay?”
In that moment, I felt like shouting. How many men in this world have been asked by Erika to protect them?
“I’ll just knock it down a bit; I’ll turn it into good burning firewood.”
I charged at the massive dragon.
Also, sorry, I lied. I did shout a little, with a voice loud enough to reach you far away.
As I charged straight in while shouting, the massive dragon’s claws awaited me. Its foreleg was bigger than a carriage.

For just a moment, I thought about showing Erika my good side by hitting it head-on, but I decided to just dodge and slice off a finger instead. The miserable thought of being blown away flashed through my mind. Mass is justice, and I had no unreasonable means to overturn that.
Erika said she would show me her good side, and she also asked me to protect her. If that’s the case, then she would do something for me. Until then, my job was to buy time.
I needed to draw its attention.
As I circled around the giant, I thought. Against its massive body, my attack power was like that of a fly. Even if I slashed with my sword, it would only scratch the surface.

The surface of the massive Forest Dragon was a faded brown, like dead wood, just as Erika had described. The protrusions on its back, which could be called a forest, resembled winter-bare trees. It looked like a turtle carrying a forest instead of a shell, but just its sheer size was enough to instill fear.
Now, what should I do? As I pondered, I suddenly realized I had already come up with an answer.
“I see, I should become a fly.”

I turned around and ducked under the dragon’s foreleg that was approaching from behind, then struck its massive head, which was about the size of my house, with all my might. I felt the dragon’s fangs break in its mouth, and I quickly let go, slicing its snout, and while escaping the dragon’s bite, I threw a dagger at its eye.
Hahaha! Annoying, isn’t it? You’ll experience the annoyance of being swarmed by flies while camping!
Just as I got cocky with my light body, the dragon’s foreleg came crashing down from above, and I hurriedly rolled to avoid it.
I thought I was successfully drawing its attention, but as I stood up, I was stunned by the sight before me.
This was way too unreasonable.

I lost my words at the sight of something even more unreasonable than the massive Forest Dragon in front of me. Erika, Erika Solnzali. The Child of Sword and Magic, a genius, the Flame-Blooded Lady, a bird swimming in the river of flames, the one I love.

A massive magic circle was being constructed at her feet, spewing forth golden magic power. This was known as an external magic circle, formally named the external construction-type auxiliary magic circle. A technique to reproduce the power of syllable magic using regular magic. Syllable magic constructs and manifests a magic circle outside through a special vocalization method and lengthy incantation, and this destructive power is reproduced using an enormous amount of magic power.
Usually, this would be constructed by multiple people, but Erika was doing it all by herself.
It was likely an act of subjugating the technique of magic through unreasonable amounts of magic power.
What arrogance! A talent that crushes raw talent, an unreasonable talent beyond comprehension.
I shivered at that unreasonableness. I wondered if my painfully ordinary self was feeling cowardly just for being beside her.
But it was simply my instincts ringing alarm bells at the dragon’s foreleg approaching me.
No, wait! I’m going to die!

Without the time to think calmly, I had to stop the dragon’s foreleg with my sword, enhanced by full body enhancement. I felt the muscles in my arm tear as I unleashed healing magic with all my might.
My feet sank into the ground under the unreasonable mass. I supported the back of my sword with my left arm, bracing the impact against the ground.
The dragon was trying to crush me with its mass.
Damn it…! Magic power mixed with my breath leaking through the gaps in my clenched teeth.
“If you can break me just by mass, then go ahead and try, you bastard!”

If my heart could be broken just by unreasonableness, I wouldn’t have played the role of a husband in this farce from the start! Don’t think a mere mortal would break just because they were shown talent!?
Ah, wait! It’s bad if my knee bone breaks at this timing.
It was the moment I heard an unpleasant sound from my knee.
“That’s quite a good retort. If it’s unreasonable, then just break it in return.”
When it exploded, flames poured from its mouth.
Just as the reputation of the Solnzali family suggested, that noble, arrogant voice caressed my ears like fire.
“Your ‘retort’ since the carriage has been quite pleasant, you know.”
In a desperate situation where I could let my guard down, I was drawn to her voice and looked at Erika.
From the magic circle constructed on the ground, magic power rose like golden threads, and in Erika’s hands, it coalesced into a spear. A flame spear made of golden magic power.
The unreasonable genius had manifested magic through unreasonable technique, and ironically, it was a spell that anyone who could use attack magic could use.
The dragon switched its target to Erika. It no longer had time to deal with a fly.
The pressure that had been supporting the dragon’s mass disappeared from my sword. Do you know what that means?
While I spat out a mere mass of sound from my throat, I flicked the dragon’s foreleg up with my sword.
The massive Forest Dragon lost its balance.
Ignoring my broken wrist, I leaped toward its head.
“Those who underestimate flies are the down payment for a house!”
I shouted as I slammed the dragon’s head into the ground.
The dragon’s head bounced off the ground, scattering clumps of dirt with its own weight.
Amidst the dense aura of death that followed, I kicked the dragon’s head and fled with all my might.
In the distorted sense of time caused by body enhancement, the image of Erika, holding the flame spear, burned into my mind.
She looked like a statue created by an artist who had devoted their life to their craft. No matter which moment was captured, it would have become a masterpiece the moment it was shaped.
I chose to ignore Shara, who was beside Erika, ready to dash away with her back turned to the dragon.
“I’ve held back, so please leave the magic stone intact, okay?”
Unreasonableness murmured further unreasonableness as she threw the golden, shining flame spear.
